annotations.title: Domain RDAP Lookup: Registration Dates, Status, Nameservers

description: Look up a domain in the public RDAP registry: registration, last-changed and expiry dates, status codes, nameservers, DNSSEC flag and registrar name. Registrant and contact details are not returned. Read-only: returns data, nothing is changed or sent. Free over MCP (30 requests a minute).
